note: Fixed before any model run. The planned trials run in exactly this order: reps outermost (1..conditions.json runs), within each rep the cases in caseOrder, within each case the conditions in conditionOrderByRep (odd reps B then S, even reps S then B). A cap stop therefore leaves the two conditions at most one trial apart. harness/run-all.mjs runs only this order; run-trial.mjs refuses a planned trial that is not the next unreserved one, any replacement before every planned trial is reserved, and any replacement that is not the next one of harness/order.mjs replacementPlan. The isolation probes (one per condition, probeCase) run before the first planned trial.
